reasons: Cited Sections 13.1–13.3 support the compliant classification: affiliates and contractors acting on Customer's behalf are expressly within the grant with no notice precondition, paid-up/embedded Vendor Technology is licensed perpetually and irrevocably, and revocation/suspension is limited to a material uncured breach after notice and cure.
Successor/Affiliate transfer is permitted under 13.3 tied to a permitted assignment, satisfying the preferred position's transferability element.

Deterministic checks confirm affiliate coverage and the absence of any at-will revocation right; no redline or counterparty comment is expected or present for a compliant finding, and the rationale is accurate.
